            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">

<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">最近正好有空,打算抽时间复盘总结一下这些年零零散散学习的AI知识.</p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">下面是目录</p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633"><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/20983335">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理目录 - GuZhenYin - 博客园</a></p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">&nbsp;</p>
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1qpe525" data-start="123" data-end="166">FFN(前馈神经网络) 到底是什么？</h1>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="194" data-end="207">在上一章中，我们已经知道,<strong>Attention</strong> 的作用是：<strong>让模型能够在生成每个 Token 时，回看并加权所有历史信息。</strong></p>
<p data-start="259" data-end="270">这解决了一个关键问题,<strong>&nbsp;“上下文相关性”</strong></p>
<p data-start="295" data-end="302">但如果我们就草率的认为Attention = 智能,&nbsp;那就错了。</p>
<p data-start="329" data-end="356">因为仅靠 Attention，其实模型还是做不到,<strong data-start="360" data-end="377">把得到的“信息”变成“推理能力”</strong></p>
<p data-start="182" data-end="205">所以其实在 Transformer 里有两个核心模块：</p>
<ul data-start="207" data-end="243">
<li data-section-id="8wdclw" data-start="207" data-end="227">Attention（负责“找关系”）</li>
<li data-section-id="jjzlip" data-start="228" data-end="243">FFN（负责“加工信息”）</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="245" data-end="260">很多人看到这里会产生一个误解,Attention 是核心，FFN 是辅助?</p>
<p data-start="287" data-end="292">不对,这完全弄反了.</p>
<p data-start="294" data-end="301">在真实模型里：</p>
<blockquote data-start="303" data-end="330">
<p data-start="305" data-end="330"><strong data-start="305" data-end="330">FFN 才是参数量最大、最“像知识”的部分</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="332" data-end="355">而 <strong>Attention 更像“信息路由系统”。</strong>所以我们先从Attention的局限性开始讲起</p>
<hr data-start="357" data-end="360">
<p data-start="362" data-end="377">&nbsp;</p>
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1s4nah" data-start="497" data-end="517">5.1 Attention 的局限性</h1>
<p data-start="519" data-end="528">我们先回到最早这句话：</p>
<blockquote data-start="530" data-end="549">
<p data-start="532" data-end="549">小明昨天去北京出差，今天他回来了。</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="551" data-end="567">Attention 能很好解决：</p>
<ul data-start="569" data-end="592">
<li data-section-id="yhm629" data-start="569" data-end="576">“他”是谁</li>
<li data-section-id="f200qn" data-start="577" data-end="585">北京指代什么</li>
<li data-section-id="1p1tz0i" data-start="586" data-end="592">时间关系</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="594" data-end="604">但是我们换一个任务：</p>
<blockquote data-start="606" data-end="619">
<p data-start="608" data-end="619">把这句话改写成正式邮件</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="621" data-end="624">或者：</p>
<blockquote data-start="626" data-end="638">
<p data-start="628" data-end="638">总结这段话的核心意思</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="640" data-end="643">或者：</p>
<blockquote data-start="645" data-end="656">
<p data-start="647" data-end="656">推理小明的行程逻辑</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="658" data-end="676">Attention 马上就会遇到一个问题,<strong>它只能“关联信息”，但不能“加工信息”。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="702" data-end="705">
<h2 data-section-id="n4538d" data-start="707" data-end="717">以做一个简单的比喻</h2>
<p data-start="719" data-end="732">Attention,它就像一个“资料整理员”.</p>
<p data-start="747" data-end="752">它很擅长：</p>
<ul data-start="754" data-end="777">
<li data-section-id="1r6knup" data-start="754" data-end="761">找相关内容</li>
<li data-section-id="1o5txoo" data-start="762" data-end="769">做信息匹配</li>
<li data-section-id="1qajgxj" data-start="770" data-end="777">拼接上下文</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="779" data-end="785">但却它不擅长：<strong>“加工、抽象、归纳”</strong></p>
<hr data-start="801" data-end="804">
<p data-start="806" data-end="829">所以 Transformer 需要第二个模块：<strong data-start="833" data-end="848">FFN（前馈神经网络）,</strong>那么FFN到底是什么呢?</p>
<hr data-start="460" data-end="463">
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="qmzuqo" data-start="855" data-end="874">5.2 FFN：真正的“加工工厂”</h1>
<p data-start="876" data-end="891">我们直接让Attention和FFN对比一下.</p>
<hr data-start="893" data-end="896">
<h2 data-section-id="1nw8iwo" data-start="898" data-end="917">Attention vs FFN</h2>
<div class="TyagGW_tableContainer">
<div class="group TyagGW_tableWrapper flex flex-col-reverse w-fit">
<table class="w-fit min-w-(--thread-content-width)" data-start="919" data-end="984">
<thead data-start="919" data-end="931">
<tr data-start="919" data-end="931"><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="919" data-end="924" data-col-size="sm">模块</th><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="924" data-end="931" data-col-size="sm">做什么</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody data-start="950" data-end="984">
<tr data-start="950" data-end="969">
<td data-start="950" data-end="962" data-col-size="sm">Attention</td>
<td data-start="962" data-end="969" data-col-size="sm">找信息</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="970" data-end="984">
<td data-start="970" data-end="976" data-col-size="sm">FFN</td>
<td data-start="976" data-end="984" data-col-size="sm">处理信息</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="986" data-end="989">
<h2 data-section-id="4raax0" data-start="991" data-end="1000">可以用后厨做一个比喻</h2>
<h3 data-section-id="1d4f8p6" data-start="1011" data-end="1025">Attention：后厨采购员</h3>
<p data-start="1040" data-end="1043">他会：</p>
<ul data-start="1045" data-end="1065">
<li data-section-id="1suonk" data-start="1045" data-end="1050">查看所有食材</li>
<li data-section-id="1r6mrf0" data-start="1051" data-end="1058">决定买什么</li>
<li data-section-id="1n7xv16" data-start="1059" data-end="1065">决定买多少</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="1067" data-end="1070">
<h3 data-section-id="yn8aaa" data-start="1072" data-end="1080">FFN：大厨</h3>
<p data-start="1093" data-end="1096">他会：</p>
<ul data-start="1098" data-end="1117">
<li data-section-id="1pwfpj5" data-start="1098" data-end="1104">将买回的食材（信息）加工</li>
<li data-section-id="1vuj5n" data-start="1105" data-end="1110">炒至成菜肴（高级特征）</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="1119" data-end="1122">
<h2 data-section-id="4ygbpd" data-start="1124" data-end="1131">回到模型</h2>
<p data-start="1133" data-end="1148">Attention 输出的是：“相关信息集合”.</p>
<p data-start="1162" data-end="1172">但 FFN 做的是：<strong data-start="1176" data-end="1196">把这些信息归纳总结后重新“加工成新的表达”.</strong></p>
<hr data-start="1198" data-end="1201">
<h2 data-section-id="98wpoq" data-start="1203" data-end="1210">我们还是找到小明~</h2>
<p data-start="1212" data-end="1215">输入：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1217" data-end="1235">
<p data-start="1219" data-end="1235">小明昨天去北京出差，今天他回来了</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1237" data-end="1252">Attention 可能输出：<code>小明 + 北京 + 出差 + 时间关系</code></p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>FFN 则会进一步加工成：<code>小明完成了一次北京出差行程</code></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="1328" data-end="1331">
<p data-start="1333" data-end="1340">所以关键区别就在于：</p>
<p data-start="1333" data-end="1340"><strong>Attention 不创造信息</strong></p>
<p data-start="1333" data-end="1340"><strong>FFN 才负责“生成新的表达能力”</strong></p>
<p data-start="1333" data-end="1340">&nbsp;</p>
<h1 data-section-id="dxv5np" data-start="465" data-end="487">5.3 FFN 的基本结构</h1>
<p data-start="489" data-end="496">在 Transformer 里，它长这样：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>输入向量<br>   ↓<br>线性变换（升维）<br>   ↓<br>激活函数（ReLU / GELU）<br>   ↓<br>线性变换（降维）<br>   ↓<br>输出向量</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="642" data-end="645">
<p data-start="647" data-end="655">用一句通俗的话讲解的话,实际上&nbsp;&nbsp;<strong>FFN = 把信息“放大 → 变形 → 压缩”的加工器</strong></p>
<hr data-start="688" data-end="691">
<h2 data-section-id="u4ca5l" data-start="693" data-end="704">这是一个比较关键的点.</h2>
<p data-start="706" data-end="718">Attention 是<strong>多个 Token 之间的信息交互</strong></p>
<p data-start="740" data-end="746">FFN 则是<strong data-start="750" data-end="774">每个 Token 自己内部的“脑内处理”</strong></p>
<hr data-start="776" data-end="779">
<p data-start="781" data-end="791">大概就是这样：</p>
<div class="TyagGW_tableContainer">
<div class="group TyagGW_tableWrapper flex flex-col-reverse w-fit">
<table class="w-fit min-w-(--thread-content-width)" data-start="793" data-end="874">
<thead data-start="793" data-end="806">
<tr data-start="793" data-end="806"><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="793" data-end="798" data-col-size="sm">模块</th><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="798" data-end="806" data-col-size="sm">作用范围</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody data-start="827" data-end="874">
<tr data-start="827" data-end="853">
<td data-start="827" data-end="839" data-col-size="sm">Attention</td>
<td data-start="839" data-end="853" data-col-size="sm">Token 之间交流</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="854" data-end="874">
<td data-start="854" data-end="860" data-col-size="sm">FFN</td>
<td data-start="860" data-end="874" data-col-size="sm">Token 自己思考</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="876" data-end="879">
<h1 data-section-id="5ukvrv" data-start="881" data-end="898">5.4 举个例子理解 FFN</h1>
<p data-start="900" data-end="908">我们继续用小明~,</p>
<blockquote data-start="910" data-end="921">
<p data-start="912" data-end="921">小明昨天去北京出差</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="923" data-end="937">Attention 做的是：</p>
<ul data-start="939" data-end="965">
<li data-section-id="31uujq" data-start="939" data-end="953">小明 ↔ 他（指代关系）</li>
<li data-section-id="18e5wpy" data-start="954" data-end="965">北京 ↔ 地点关系</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="967" data-end="970">
<p data-start="972" data-end="982">但 FFN 做的是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="984" data-end="999">
<p data-start="986" data-end="999">“这句话整体是什么意思？”</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1001" data-end="1004">
<p data-section-id="t3jlpr" data-start="1006" data-end="1024">把FFN 的工作方式比喻为人类学习方式的话</p>
<p data-start="1026" data-end="1032">我们可以理解为</p>
<p data-start="1026" data-end="1032">Attention---你在查资料</p>
<p data-section-id="yn8aaa" data-start="1059" data-end="1067">FFN---你在理解资料</p>
<hr data-start="1079" data-end="1082">
<h2 data-section-id="1vd67zp" data-start="1084" data-end="1092">继续请出我们的老演员,小明~~</h2>
<p data-start="1094" data-end="1100">同一条信息：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>小明昨天去北京出差</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1136" data-end="1151">Attention 看到的是：</p>
<ul data-start="1153" data-end="1174">
<li data-section-id="yhuk5l" data-start="1153" data-end="1157">小明</li>
<li data-section-id="yhvdbn" data-start="1158" data-end="1162">北京</li>
<li data-section-id="yhvipo" data-start="1163" data-end="1167">出差</li>
<li data-section-id="1p1tz0i" data-start="1168" data-end="1174">时间关系</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="1176" data-end="1179">
<p data-start="1181" data-end="1198">但 FFN 会则会抽象和重组整个信息：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1200" data-end="1220">
<p data-start="1202" data-end="1220">把这些“碎片信息”组合成一个新的表达</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1222" data-end="1225">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>一次商务出行事件 </code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="1260" data-end="1263">
<p data-start="1265" data-end="1271">注意：</p>
<p data-start="1273" data-end="1286">这一步不是纯“检索”，而是有计算：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1288" data-end="1306">
<p data-start="1290" data-end="1306"><strong data-start="1290" data-end="1306">压缩 + 抽象 + 重组</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1308" data-end="1311">
<h1 data-section-id="1o694b2" data-start="1313" data-end="1336">5.5 FFN 的本质：逐点“非线性变换”</h1>
<hr data-start="1358" data-end="1361">
<h2 data-section-id="1b4uio8" data-start="1363" data-end="1375">FFN 做的事情:</h2>
<p data-start="1377" data-end="1391">对每一个 Token 向量：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1393" data-end="1407">
<p data-start="1395" data-end="1407">单独做一次“非线性加工”</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1409" data-end="1412">
<h2 data-section-id="1yaih7j" data-start="1414" data-end="1424">什么叫非线性？</h2>
<h3 data-section-id="1d59ydi" data-start="1433" data-end="1446">线性 = 机械加减</h3>
<p data-start="1448" data-end="1451">例如：</p>
<ul data-start="1453" data-end="1482">
<li data-section-id="1xxv4hc" data-start="1453" data-end="1467">小明 + 1 = 小明？</li>
<li data-section-id="py586r" data-start="1468" data-end="1482">北京 + 2 = 北京？</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1484" data-end="1488">没有意义</p>
<hr data-start="1490" data-end="1493">
<h3 data-section-id="198ezw1" data-start="1495" data-end="1510">非线性 = 产生新语义</h3>
<p data-start="1512" data-end="1515">例如：</p>
<p data-start="1517" data-end="1520">输入：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1522" data-end="1538">
<p data-start="1524" data-end="1538">“小明 + 出差 + 北京”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1540" data-end="1543">输出：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1545" data-end="1553">
<p data-start="1547" data-end="1553">“商务活动”</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1555" data-end="1558">
<p data-start="1560" data-end="1573">👉 FFN 的作用就是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1575" data-end="1597">
<p data-start="1577" data-end="1597">把“简单叠加的信息”变成“新的语义结构”</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1599" data-end="1602">
<h1 data-section-id="ey33xs" data-start="1604" data-end="1627">5.6 FFN 的关键结构：升维 → 压缩</h1>
<p data-start="1629" data-end="1643">这是 FFN 最核心的设计。</p>
<hr data-start="1645" data-end="1648">
<h2 data-section-id="gltq88" data-start="1650" data-end="1670">Step 1：升维（Expand）</h2>
<p data-start="1672" data-end="1678">把一个向量：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>768维</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1709" data-end="1713">扩展成：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>3072维</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="1745" data-end="1748">
<p data-start="1750" data-end="1760">为什么要升维？</p>
<p data-start="1762" data-end="1765">因为升维之后才能存储更多信息.</p>
<blockquote data-start="1767" data-end="1788">
<p data-start="1769" data-end="1788">空间变大 → 可以表达更多“组合关系”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1802" data-end="1809">我们可以理解为：</p>
<p data-start="1811" data-end="1817">原来只有一块钱,升维之后, 你就有了5块钱, 你可以购买和组合购买更多的东西.</p>
<hr data-start="1856" data-end="1859">
<h2 data-section-id="eex6yg" data-start="1861" data-end="1889">Step 2：非线性变换（ReLU / GELU）</h2>
<p data-start="1891" data-end="1899">这一层只做一件事：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1901" data-end="1919">
<p data-start="1903" data-end="1919"><strong data-start="1903" data-end="1919">筛选 + 激活 + 抑制</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1921" data-end="1924">
<p data-start="1926" data-end="1932">我们可以简单理解为,通过算法将有用的信息放大,将没用的信息压缩.</p>
<hr data-start="1955" data-end="1958">
<h2 data-section-id="v505p4" data-start="1960" data-end="1986">Step 3：降维（Project back）</h2>
<p data-start="1988" data-end="1991">再从：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">

<p data-start="2023" data-end="2026">压回：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">

<hr data-start="2057" data-end="2060">
<p data-start="2062" data-end="2068">最终的结果就是已经不是原来的向量了，而是“加工后的语义”</p>
<hr data-start="2093" data-end="2096">
<h1 data-section-id="1nvpa4i" data-start="2098" data-end="2125">&nbsp;</h1>
<h1 data-section-id="iobd7t" data-start="2368" data-end="2392">5.7 为什么说 FFN 是“知识存储器”？</h1>
<p data-start="2394" data-end="2408">这是一个非常关键的现代观点。</p>
<p data-start="2424" data-end="2429">研究发现,在大模型里面FFN 参数量远远大于 Attention 参数量</p>
<p data-section-id="1gfa4kx" data-start="2471" data-end="2480">这说明模型大部分“知识”不在 Attention，而在 FFN</p>
<p data-start="2533" data-end="2540">我们可以这样理解：</p>
<p data-start="2533" data-end="2540">Attention：查询系统（类似搜索引擎）</p>
<p data-start="2533" data-end="2540">FFN：数据库本体（真正存知识）</p>
<hr data-start="2610" data-end="2613">
<h2 data-section-id="1n0btc" data-start="2615" data-end="2620">举个例子</h2>
<p data-start="2622" data-end="2624">你问大模型：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2626" data-end="2638">
<p data-start="2628" data-end="2638">Redis 是什么？</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2640" data-end="2643">
<p data-start="2645" data-end="2657">模型不是去“想”，而是：</p>
<ul data-start="2659" data-end="2723">
<li data-section-id="att9sd" data-start="2659" data-end="2723">FFN 中已经学到：
<ul data-start="2674" data-end="2723">
<li data-section-id="atlfw8" data-start="2674" data-end="2686">Redis → 缓存</li>
<li data-section-id="8wrenl" data-start="2689" data-end="2707">Redis → KV store</li>
<li data-section-id="1iepch" data-start="2710" data-end="2723">Redis → 高性能</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="2730" data-end="2736">所以反而FFN 更像“隐式的知识库”</p>
<hr data-start="3165" data-end="3168">
<h1 data-section-id="1vqmlre" data-start="3170" data-end="3192">5.8 总结一下FFN 的真实作用</h1>
<p data-section-id="1vqmlre" data-start="3170" data-end="3192">写了这么多,其实我们可以总结一下FFN的真实作用.</p>
<p data-section-id="1vqmlre" data-start="3170" data-end="3192">Attention 负责“连接信息”，FFN 负责“理解信息”，Transformer则是用多层 FFN 逐步构建抽象能力。</p>
<h1 data-section-id="1sbaufz" data-start="3279" data-end="3290">&nbsp;</h1>
<h1 data-section-id="1sbaufz" data-start="3279" data-end="3290">本章总结</h1>
<h2 data-section-id="78ofv7" data-start="3314" data-end="3327">① FFN 是什么？</h2>
<blockquote data-start="3329" data-end="3353">
<p data-start="3331" data-end="3353">两层线性变换 + 非线性激活的“信息加工器”</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="3355" data-end="3358">
<h2 data-section-id="b0mlut" data-start="3360" data-end="3384">② FFN 和 Attention 的区别</h2>
<div class="TyagGW_tableContainer">
<div class="group TyagGW_tableWrapper flex flex-col-reverse w-fit">
<table class="w-fit min-w-(--thread-content-width)" data-start="3386" data-end="3447">
<thead data-start="3386" data-end="3397">
<tr data-start="3386" data-end="3397"><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="3386" data-end="3391" data-col-size="sm">模块</th><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="3391" data-end="3397" data-col-size="sm">功能</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody data-start="3414" data-end="3447">
<tr data-start="3414" data-end="3433">
<td data-start="3414" data-end="3426" data-col-size="sm">Attention</td>
<td data-start="3426" data-end="3433" data-col-size="sm">找关系</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="3434" data-end="3447">
<td data-start="3434" data-end="3440" data-col-size="sm">FFN</td>
<td data-start="3440" data-end="3447" data-col-size="sm">做理解</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="3449" data-end="3452">
<h2 data-section-id="ymmkbt" data-start="3454" data-end="3466">③ FFN 的本质</h2>
<p data-section-id="ymmkbt" data-start="3454" data-end="3466">对每个 Token 做“非线性语义变换”</p>
<hr data-start="3492" data-end="3495">
<h2 data-section-id="1tn1flt" data-start="3497" data-end="3514">④ 为什么 FFN 很重要？</h2>
<p data-start="3516" data-end="3519">因为它才是模型“知识和语义能力”的主要来源</p>
<p data-start="3516" data-end="3519">也正是这个看似简单的“升维-激活-降维”三步曲，赋予了Transformer深度思考的能力，使其从简单的信息收集器变成了真正的理解者和创造者。</p>
<hr data-start="3544" data-end="3547">
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="1110" data-end="1155"><strong>当然，在现代大模型中，FFN 已经发展出多种不同的实现范式，而不仅仅是传统的两层前馈结构。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1168" data-end="1237"><strong data-start="1168" data-end="1182">SwiGLU FFN</strong>：通过门控机制（Gating）替代传统激活函数，使模型能够在特征维度上进行选择性放大与抑制，从而提升表达能力。</p>
<p data-start="1242" data-end="1347"><strong data-start="1242" data-end="1271">MoE（Mixture of Experts）结构</strong>：将传统的单一 FFN 扩展为多个“专家网络”，并通过路由机制（Router）动态选择部分专家参与计算，使模型在参数规模大幅提升的同时保持计算成本可控。</p>
<p data-start="1352" data-end="1394">这些结构本质上并不是简单的“优化”，而是 FFN 在不同设计目标下的结构性演化。</p>
<p data-start="1399" data-end="1438">这里篇幅有限,就不过多赘述了.&nbsp; 我们下一章在讲.</p>
<p data-start="1399" data-end="1438">开始进入深水区了 白话描述逐渐困难了&nbsp; 哈哈哈 - - ..</p>
<p data-start="1399" data-end="1438">&nbsp;</p>
